data.content:
The Blazor Web App is ready. Here's what was created:

**Project structure:**
- `Models/Recipe.cs` — Recipe and RecipeSubmission models
- `Services/RecipeService.cs` — Singleton service with sample recipes (8 recipes across 4 categories)
- `Components/Pages/Home.razor` — Homepage with category grid (static SSR)
- `Components/Pages/Category.razor` — Browse recipes by category (static SSR)
- `Components/Pages/RecipeDetail.razor` — Full recipe view with interactive rating
- `Components/Pages/SubmitRecipe.razor` — Interactive form (`@rendermode InteractiveServer`)
- `Components/Shared/StarRating.razor` — Click-to-rate widget (`@rendermode InteractiveServer`)

**Render mode strategy:** Most pages render as static server-side HTML. Only the star-rating widget and submit form use `InteractiveServer` mode, keeping the app lightweight while enabling interactivity where needed.

Run with `dotnet run` from the `RecipeCommunity/` directory.
